author: Hereidos
quote: Having played the previous entries in the series, I feel this one doesn't do them justice. It bears the name, but it lacks the essence. On the positive side, the graphics are impressive, and the map is absolutely massive—though, at the same time, it feels somewhat empty. It’s not a bad game, but it could have been better.

author: Hereidos
quote: Getting to play the best game of all time again—now enhanced—is a dream come true. From the graphics and the details to the sound and the music, everything feels even more magical than it did when I first played it back in 1998.
game_title: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time
